speech_en: Sort it, tag it, wrap it — next parcel please!
speech_de: Sortieren, etikettieren, einpacken — das nächste Päckchen bitte!
scenario: A cheerful Golgi apparatus character — a stack of five pancake-shaped sacs curved into a shallow smile, with one big face on the front of the stack and two stubby mitten hands — running a parcel-sorting depot inside a cell. A friendly bumpy endoplasmic-reticulum ribbon hands over little vesicle characters carrying plain parcels at the lower left (the cis side); finished bubble-parcels with ribbon bows float away out of the cupped top (the trans side), one still attached by a thin neck. A sleepy nucleus fills the upper-left corner and two bean-shaped mitochondria sit at the left and right edges, all cut off by the frame so the art bleeds off all four sides.
status: RENDERED — accepted on attempt 1 with gemini-3-pro-image. Checked against the two hard failure modes: NO starburst / radiating burst / sparkle rays anywhere, and NO frame, box, border line or white margin band — the artwork is cut off by all four image edges. The traced A4 page was viewed after tracing and is clean. Two honest imperfections kept rather than re-rolled (a re-roll risks introducing a burst or a frame, which cannot be repaired afterwards): (1) a short dashed motion line with a small arrowhead runs between the three arriving vesicle characters, although the prompt forbade arrows; (2) the five cisternae of the stack read as a slightly fused burger-like pile rather than five cleanly separated pancakes, so the cis/trans polarity is softer here than in the scientific plates. Both are acceptable for a kids' colouring page. The German speech line was written into the SVG with proper umlauts by patching the text layer directly, so no second render was paid for.

prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080. Composition must be SQUARE, never wide or landscape.

CRITICAL — READ FIRST: (a) the drawing must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES with NO frame, NO border line, NO box and NO white margin band; (b) there must be NO starburst, no radiating burst and no sparkle rays anywhere in the picture.

SCENE: A cheerful cartoon GOLGI APPARATUS character is running a busy little parcel-sorting depot inside a cell.
- The GOLGI CHARACTER is a neat PILE OF FIVE BIG FLAT PANCAKE-SHAPED SACS stacked one above the other, like a stack of five thick pancakes or five squashed cushions, each one drawn as a separate closed shape with a clear white gap between it and the sacs above and below. The whole pile is gently curved like a shallow smile, so the bottom pancake bulges downward and the top pancake is cupped upward like a shallow bowl. Each pancake is a simple rounded flattened blob whose two ends swell into fat rounded knobs. The BIG FRIENDLY FACE belongs to the whole stack and sits on the front of the middle pancakes: two large round eyes with pupils, cheerful curved eyebrows and a wide happy open grin. Two short stubby cartoon arms with simple mitten hands reach out from the sides of the stack — one hand is catching a little parcel-bubble arriving from the left, the other is patting a finished parcel-bubble on its way out at the upper right.
- ARRIVING FROM THE LOWER LEFT: a friendly wavy ribbon character, the ENDOPLASMIC RETICULUM — a long, broad, gently folded ribbon-shaped noodle with big simple round bumps dotted along its outside edge, and its own small happy face with two dot eyes and a little smile at its near end. It is handing over three small round BUBBLE CHARACTERS (transport vesicles): simple circles with tiny dot eyes and small smiles, floating in a line toward the bottom of the Golgi stack, each hugging a plain rounded parcel shape.
- LEAVING FROM THE TOP RIGHT: four larger round BUBBLE CHARACTERS (finished parcels) floating up and away out of the cupped top of the stack. Each is a big open circle with a simple happy face, and inside each one sit two or three plain rounded blobs of cargo. Give two of them a simple ribbon bow on top, like a wrapped present. One of them is still joined to the top of the stack by a short thin neck, as if just being pinched off.
- BACKGROUND, filling the rest of the picture and running off the edges: a big friendly rounded NUCLEUS character in the upper left corner with a simple sleepy smiling face, cut off by the corner of the image; two chunky bean-shaped MITOCHONDRIA characters with simple faces and a few wavy folds inside, one at the lower right and one at the far left, both partly cut off by the image edge; and a loose scatter of small plain circles and tiny dots floating in the open space to suggest the cell's interior.
- Everything is drawn LARGE, SIMPLE and CHUNKY, with generous open white areas inside every shape so a child can colour them in.

STYLE — coloring book line art:
- BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed.
- ABSOLUTELY NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO stippling, NO cross-hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black areas anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only).
- Simple, cheerful, chunky cartoon shapes with plenty of white space.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN — the page is rejected if any of these appear:
- ANY decorative STARBURST, comic-style radiating burst, "pow"/impact star, sparkle burst, twinkle burst, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, motion rays or halo of rays behind, around or under any character. NO radiating lines of any kind anywhere. They leave a big empty shape that cannot be removed afterwards.
- ANY rectangle, rounded rectangle, square box outline, picture frame, panel edge, comic panel, border line, outer margin line, ground-line box, shelf, table, counter or vignette. The drawing must NOT sit inside a box of any kind. Do NOT draw a thin black line anywhere near the edge of the image. There must be NO white margin between the artwork and the image edge.
- The artwork must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES of the square — the nucleus, the mitochondria and the endoplasmic-reticulum ribbon are CUT OFF by the image edge itself.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, address labels, stamps, postmarks, signatures or watermarks anywhere. Parcels and boxes must be completely blank.
- NO speech bubble, thought bubble or balloon of any kind (one is added separately afterwards).
- NO conveyor belt, no machinery, no cogs, no crates, no cardboard boxes, no shelves, no post-office building, no van, no truck — the depot is made only of the cell's own soft rounded shapes.
- NO tiny dots, beads, bumps or circles studding the Golgi pancakes themselves — only the endoplasmic-reticulum ribbon carries the round bumps along its edge.
- NO human figures, no hands, no arrows.
